/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

&Options = new()
&OptionsDesc = new()
&OptionIndexes = new()
LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'LoadGridState'
Do Case
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_CARRETENOSERIE'
		Do 'LoadCarreteNoSerieOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_CARRETEOBSERVACION'
		Do 'LoadCarreteObservacionOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_CARRETEPALETSERIE'
		Do 'LoadCarretePaletSerieOptions'
EndCase

&OptionsJson = &Options.ToJson()
&OptionsDescJson = &OptionsDesc.ToJson()
&OptionIndexesJson = &OptionIndexes.ToJson()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"DB.PaletPaletCarreteWCGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(!"DB.PaletPaletCarreteWCGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"DB.PaletPaletCarreteWCGridState"))
	Endif	

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFCARRETENOSERIE"
				&TFCarreteNoSerie.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFCARRETENOSERIE_SEL"
				&TFCarreteNoSerie_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFCARRETENOLINEA"
				&TFCarreteNoLinea.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFCarreteNoLinea_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFCARRETEESTADO_SEL"
				&TFCarreteEstado_SelsJson = &GridStateFilterValue.Value
				&TFCarreteEstado_Sels.FromJson(&TFCarreteEstado_SelsJson)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFCARRETEENMOLINO_SEL"
				&TFCarreteEnMolino_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFCARRETEMOLINO_SEL"
				&TFCarreteMolino_SelsJson = &GridStateFilterValue.Value
				&TFCarreteMolino_Sels.FromJson(&TFCarreteMolino_SelsJson)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFCARRETEOBSERVACION"
				&TFCarreteObservacion.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFCARRETEOBSERVACION_SEL"
				&TFCarreteObservacion_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFCARRETETERMINAPALET_SEL"
				&TFCarreteTerminaPalet_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFCARRETECARRERAID"
				&TFCarreteCarreraId.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFCarreteCarreraId_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFCARRETEMERMAMOLINO_SEL"
				&TFCarreteMermaMolino_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFCARRETEMERMAKG"
				&TFCarreteMermaKg.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFCarreteMermaKg_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFCARRETEPALETSERIE"
				&TFCarretePaletSerie.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFCARRETEPALETSERIE_SEL"
				&TFCarretePaletSerie_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"PARM_&PALETID"
				&PaletId.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
		EndCase
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadCarreteNoSerieOptions'

&FilterFullText.ToLower() AND CarreteMolino = !"Corte Desviado (gancho)") OR ("corte largo" like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND CarreteMolino = !"Corte Largo") OR ("fajilla incompleta (mal &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND CarreteMolino = !"Retales Adherido") OR ("retales sueltos" like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND CarreteMolino = !"Retales Sueltos") OR ("rebaba (pelito)" like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND CarreteMolino = !"Rebaba (pelito)") OR ("marca de rebaba" like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND CarreteMolino = !"Marca De Rebaba") OR ("escalón o corte chueco like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND CarreteMolino = !"Estirado Entre Packs Por Tensión") OR ("linea con rasgadura (por filo en mesa)" like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND CarreteMolino = !"Linea Con Rasgadura (por filo en mesa)") OR ("otros" like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND CarreteMolino = !"Otros") OR ("n/a" like !'%' + &FilterFullText.ToLower() AND CarreteMolino = !"N/A") OR (CarreteObservacion like !'%' + &FilterFullText) OR (CarreteCarreraId.ToString() like !'%' + &FilterFullText) OR (CarreteMermaKg.ToString() like !'%' + &FilterFullText) OR (CarretePaletSerie like !'%' + &FilterFullText) When not &FilterFullText.IsEmpty()
		Where CarreteNoSerie like &TFCarreteNoSerie when &TFCarreteNoSerie_Sel.IsEmpty() AND (not &TFCarreteNoSerie.IsEmpty())
		Where CarreteNoSerie = &TFCarreteNoSerie_Sel when not &TFCarreteNoSerie_Sel.IsEmpty()
		Where CarreteNoLinea >= &TFCarreteNoLinea when not &TFCarreteNoLinea.IsEmpty()
		Where CarreteNoLinea <= &TFCarreteNoLinea_To when not &TFCarreteNoLinea_To.IsEmpty()
		Where CarreteEstado in &TFCarreteEstado_Sels when &TFCarreteEstado_Sels.Count > 0
		Where CarreteEnMolino = True when &TFCarreteEnMolino_Sel = 1
		Where CarreteEnMolino = False when &TFCarreteEnMolino_Sel = 2
		Where CarreteMolino in &TFCarreteMolino_Sels when &TFCarreteMolino_Sels.Count > 0
		Where CarreteObservacion like &TFCarreteObservacion when &TFCarreteObservacion_Sel.IsEmpty() AND (not &TFCarreteObservacion.IsEmpty())
		Where CarreteObservacion = &TFCarreteObservacion_Sel when not &TFCarreteObservacion_Sel.IsEmpty()
		Where CarreteTerminaPalet = True when &TFCarreteTerminaPalet_Sel = 1
		Where CarreteTerminaPalet = False when &TFCarreteTerminaPalet_Sel = 2
		Where CarreteCarreraId >= &TFCarreteCarreraId when not &TFCarreteCarreraId.IsEmpty()
		Where CarreteCarreraId <= &TFCarreteCarreraId_To when not &TFCarreteCarreraId_To.IsEmpty()
		Where CarreteMermaMolino = True when &TFCarreteMermaMolino_Sel = 1
		Where CarreteMermaMolino = False when &TFCarreteMermaMolino_Sel = 2
		Where CarreteMermaKg >= &TFCarreteMermaKg when not &TFCarreteMermaKg.IsEmpty()
		Where CarreteMermaKg <= &TFCarreteMermaKg_To when not &TFCarreteMermaKg_To.IsEmpty()
		Where CarretePaletSerie like &TFCarretePaletSerie when &TFCarretePaletSerie_Sel.IsEmpty() AND (not &TFCarretePaletSerie.IsEmpty())
		Where CarretePaletSerie = &TFCarretePaletSerie_Sel when not &TFCarretePaletSerie_Sel.IsEmpty()

		&count = 0
		For Each PaletCarrete
			Order PaletId, CarreteNoSerie
			&count += 1
		EndFor
		If not CarreteNoSerie.IsEmpty()
			&Option = CarreteNoSerie
			
			&Options.Add(&Option)
			&OptionIndexes.Add(trim(&count.ToFormattedString()))
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

EndSub
